objs.name: policy
objs.description: Company-wide regulation and process at strategic level

objs.name: guideline
objs.description: Company-wide or locally defined regulation or instruction

objs.name: procedural_instruction
objs.description: Specific procedure within a framework or process sequence with details and responsible persons

objs.name: work_instruction
objs.description: Detailed steps for special work tasks, test instructions, and compliance criteria

objs.name: document
objs.description: General container for policies, guidelines, procedural instructions, work instructions, and other managed content

objs.name: additional_information
objs.description: Non-critical document attachment not subject to main document release cycle

objs.name: attachment
objs.description: Controlled document automatically released with main document release

objs.name: change_proposal
objs.description: Proposed amendment to a document managed without affecting content or version history of the main document

objs.name: validity_extension_request
objs.description: System-generated request to check and extend document validity after defined period

objs.name: override_request
objs.description: Request to invalidate and archive a document that has no additional validity

objs.name: reactivation_request
objs.description: Request to re-validate and restore an archived document

objs.name: user
objs.description: System participant with assigned roles and permissions

objs.name: author
objs.description: User assigned to create and modify documents

objs.name: co_author
objs.description: User with additional change rights on a document

objs.name: reviewer
objs.description: User assigned to check document content for technical and formal aspects

objs.name: releaser
objs.description: User responsible for deciding document distribution to readers

objs.name: translator
objs.description: User assigned to translate released document content into another language

objs.name: reader
objs.description: User assigned to view approved documents

objs.name: user_group
objs.description: Collection of users with shared authorization and distribution attributes

objs.name: acknowledgement
objs.description: Confirmation by a user of receipt and review of a released document

objs.name: signature
objs.description: Electronic signature documenting workflow participant approval

objs.name: distribution_list
objs.description: Collection of user groups or persons designated to receive document notifications

evts.name: attach_document
evts.description: Create new document object in system with selection of document type and template

evts.name: maintain_metadata
evts.description: Edit standardized and customer-specific metadata and properties of a document

evts.name: edit_content
evts.description: Modify document content using integrated editing client and office components

evts.name: convert_to_pdf
evts.description: System automatically converts edited document to PDF format for web display

evts.name: assign_authorization
evts.description: Define and assign read, write, and role-specific permissions to users and user groups

evts.name: assign_release_workflow_participant
evts.description: Designate author, reviewer, and releaser for document approval process

evts.name: attach_additional_information
evts.description: Add non-critical document attachment directly to a document

evts.name: attach_controlled_attachment
evts.description: Add controlled document attachment that triggers new version of main document

evts.name: initiate_release_workflow
evts.description: Start 3-step approval process consisting of creator, review, and release steps

evts.name: sign_document
evts.description: Complete workflow step with electronic signature by participating user

evts.name: publish_document
evts.description: Make released document visible to designated readers after final approval

evts.name: create_new_version
evts.description: Automatically generate new document version when released version is revised

evts.name: archive_attachment
evts.description: Mark controlled attachment as no longer relevant to current document version

evts.name: create_change_proposal
evts.description: Submit proposed amendment to document without affecting current version or history

evts.name: implement_change_proposal
evts.description: Create new document version incorporating approved change proposal

evts.name: generate_validity_extension_request
evts.description: System automatically creates request when document reaches 30 days before validity expiration

evts.name: process_validity_extension
evts.description: Workflow-supported check and extension of document validity by authorized participants

evts.name: create_override_request
evts.description: Initiate workflow to invalidate and archive document determined to have no additional validity

evts.name: execute_override
evts.description: Declare document and attachments invalid, revoke authorizations except for archive group

evts.name: create_reactivation_request
evts.description: Initiate workflow to re-validate and restore an archived document

evts.name: execute_reactivation
evts.description: Confirm reactivation and create new version of previously invalidated document with restored status

evts.name: maintain_distribution_list
evts.description: Assign user groups or persons to document distribution for email or acknowledgement

evts.name: send_distribution_email
evts.description: Notify assigned users of released document version via email

evts.name: request_acknowledgement
evts.description: Send workflow-supported request to users to actively confirm document receipt and review

evts.name: confirm_acknowledgement
evts.description: User completes acknowledgement workflow without signature

evts.name: translate_document
evts.description: Create language-dependent version of released document content

evts.name: release_translation
evts.description: Workflow-supported check and approval of translated document version

evts.name: specify_multi_client_visibility
evts.description: Define which clients can view a document in multi-client system
